snippet.title: SCREEN CROSS | Crosswords Party Game
snippet.description:
The pastime that spanned generations has evolved into a party game.


The newspaper crossword came off the page — the big screen is the board, every phone in the room is a pen. 

Each round brings a new theme with clues that start cryptic and get clearer as the timer runs down — guess on a hunch or wait for the picture to sharpen. 

Two modes: score or round match (built for game night at home) and subathon (made for streamers running the game live for hours). 

Great for Sunday with family, happy hour with friends, the classroom, and even the work video call to wind down. No signup, no download — scan the QR and play.

PLAY NOW! https://scross.tv/
